messages:
pagerduty-bot: INC01234 triggered for gpu-pool-6 — high OOM rate observed on paged-attention allocator. Affected nodes: gpu-6a, gpu-6b. Error class: CUDA OOM / container crashloop. Severity: P1.

pagerduty-bot: Alerts aggregated from 172.16.40.0/24, 172.16.41.0/24. 98% of failures are OOM-exits from runtime-prod v2.3.1.

tess (oncall): taking this. seeing crashloops on gpu-6a at ~10:02 UTC. 99th latency spikes and token truncation for a subset of hosted requests. @miko any quick reads from runtime metrics?

miko (eng-runtime): looking. KV cache used by paged-attn shows steady growth in "page_allocated" with low eviction rate. suspect fragmentation/slow leak. attaching sample logs.

miko (eng-runtime): ```
[2026-03-15 10:01:58] runtime: alloc_page id=0x7f9e2fa size=4MB slab=page_pool free=12
[2026-03-15 10:02:04] runtime: fail alloc_page id=0x7f9e2fa size=8MB (OOM) GPU=0
Trace: kernel.cu:453 memcpy_async -> paged_allocator.cpp:210 allocate_page -> kv_cache.cpp:897 store_kv_page
```

sam-rt: nvidia-smi on gpu-6a right now shows high RESERVED memory but processes not accounting properly. possible stale allocations.

sam-rt: ```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.54       Driver Version: 535.54       CUDA Version: 12.2     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0   A100-SXM-80GB      On      | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off | N/A                   |
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
|    0     -    -     41234      C   python serving_main.py           60288MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

len (eng-sre): I'll cordon gpu-6a and drain if we think it's unsafe to keep routing. recommend quick traffic shift to gpu-4 pool to buy time.

ross (infra): spinning up warm nodes in gpu-4 now. routing rule change ETA ~90s. I'll also increase node autoscaler cooldown to avoid thrash.

tess (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic off gpu-6a -> gpu-4, 2) force restart runtime pods on gpu-6a, 3) enable aggressive KV eviction temporarily, 4) run defrag job.

miko (eng-runtime): do NOT restart the whole node yet — restarting runtime pods will drop KV prefix cache and cause some cold latency; but it's safer than letting OOM continue. To enable eviction without deploy: set dynamic config via /admin/flags.

miko (eng-runtime): admin command: ```
curl -X POST https://runtime-admin.internal/flags 
 -d '{"REDWOOD_PAGED_EVICT_PERCENT": "30", "KV_DEFRAG_ENABLED": "1"}' 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

infra-bot: routing: set route "hosted-gen" -> gpu-4 pool (shift 100%) by ross at 10:05:42 UTC.

julia-cs: FYI: Customer "calendly-inc" reported ~5 minutes of 500s for their embed generation around 10:03 UTC. I've opened a ticket and told them we are investigating.

tess (oncall): len / ross — please proceed. I'll run the admin flag change now and then restart pods on gpu-6a. Expect transient failures during drain.

len (eng-sre): cordon gpu-6a -> done. drain start -> ```kubectl drain gpu-6a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```

len (eng-sre): pods evicted, restart of runtime-prod pods done on gpu-6a. Observed immediate drop in resident GPU memory for runtime containers.

miko (eng-runtime): after eviction & restart we saw page_allocated drop ~18% but page_bitmap fragmentation still up. will kick off defrag job now (background compaction).

miko (eng-runtime): defrag job logs: ```
[10:08:31] defrag: scanning slab 3/8, reclaimed 128MB, moved 24 pages
[10:08:34] defrag: scanning slab 4/8, reclaimed 220MB, moved 41 pages
[10:08:43] defrag: complete on node gpu-6a, reclaimed 1.2GB total
```

sam-rt: runtime metrics show OOM exit rate down to baseline after defrag and eviction flags. latency 99p trending back to normal.

tess (oncall): rolling back aggressive flags to conservative levels in 10m unless we see recurrence. leave defrag enabled.

len (eng-sre): keeping gpu-6a cordoned for now until we validate stability for 30m. ross: routing will keep traffic on gpu-4 for 15m as buffer.

julia-cs: updated calendly-inc ticket with RCA-in-progress and ETA for full restoration ~30-45 minutes. they asked for postmortem once stable.

miko (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause hypothesis: incremental page fragmentation combined with a slab allocation path regression in v2.3.1 that reduced coalescing under certain token distributions (long context tails). fragmentation caused orphaned pages which slowly accumulated until OOM on allocation path.

miko (eng-runtime): next actions: 1) hotfix to patch allocator coalescing (small PR), 2) add metric for orphaned_pages ratio and alert threshold, 3) scheduled job for periodic KV defrag on warm nodes.

tess (oncall): great. I'll hand off to @miko for post-incident follow-up and to @len for node/recovery cleanup. Leaving the channel. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: INC01234 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated. severity downgraded to P2 at 10:21 UTC after stabilization.

len (eng-sre): gpu-6a uncordon planned at 10:55 UTC after 30m stable window.

miko (eng-runtime): opening followup ticket: INFRA-5879 with details and linking PR for allocator fix. will include prompt sets and regen tests to catch fragmentation cases.

julia-cs: I'll follow up with customers and close tickets once we confirm no further regressions.

tess (oncall): back on duty for next shift. good job folks.
